browsers.name: Arc
browsers.tagline: Chromium browser with sidebar Spaces; stops working December 22, 2026

featureNotes.tabFolders: Pinned tabs can be grouped into folders, and folders can sit inside other folders.
featureNotes.easels: Easels still ship but only on Arc for macOS; they can't be created or edited on Windows.
featureNotes.airTrafficControl: Air Traffic Control link routing is available on Arc for macOS only; Arc for Windows has no equivalent.

browsers.name: Dia
browsers.tagline: Chromium browser with built-in AI chat, from Arc's makers
browsers.priceNote: $20/mo Dia Pro for unlimited AI chat and skills

featureNotes.tabFolders: Tab groups can be renamed, recoloured and collapsed in the sidebar, but no nesting is documented.
featureNotes.autoArchiveTabs: Tidy Tabs is off by default; when on, it moves inactive tabs to Recently Closed once a day.
featureNotes.miniPlayer: Picture-in-picture activates when switching away from Meet or YouTube; not documented for every site.
featureNotes.favorites: Arc Favorites become icon-only pinned tabs in Dia, and each Profile has its own tabs; nothing says Favorites appear in every Profile.

browsers.vibeCodedNote: Dia is closed source and was built in 2024–2025, and The Browser Company has made no statement on whether it was written mostly with AI coding tools.

browsers.name: Zen Browser
browsers.tagline: Firefox-based browser with vertical tabs, Spaces, split view and Glance

featureNotes.tabFolders: Sidebar folders can hold sub-folders, and folders sync and can be shared by link.
featureNotes.miniPlayer: Zen offers manual picture-in-picture, while automatic pop-out on tab switch is off by default and only available through the about:config pref media.videocontrols.picture-in-picture.enable-when-switching-tabs.enabled.
featureNotes.adBlocking: Firefox's built-in tracker blocking is on, but ads are blocked only if you accept the uBlock Origin extension offered during setup.

browsers.name: Orion
browsers.tagline: WebKit browser from Kagi that runs Chrome and Firefox extensions

featureNotes.pinnedTabs: Pinned tabs can be reset to their pinned page, but closing one removes it.
featureNotes.tabFolders: Tab Groups are named windows you switch between, not folders in the sidebar, and they don't nest.
featureNotes.spaces: Tab Groups are named windows and profiles open in separate windows; there is no documented sidebar space switcher.
featureNotes.siteCustomization: Page Tweaks offers preset changes such as dark mode, fonts and hiding elements, but no custom CSS or JS.
featureNotes.arcImport: Arc import covers bookmarks, history and passwords; Spaces and pinned tabs are not mentioned.
featureNotes.easels: Built-in Notes and a full-page screenshot tool, but no canvas.
featureNotes.favorites: Orion has a bookmarks bar, but pinned tabs belong to individual windows or tab groups rather than appearing in all of them.
featureNotes.builtInAI: The only AI feature is page summarization through Kagi's summarizer, which needs a paid Kagi subscription.
featureNotes.chromeExtensions: Kagi says about 70% of WebExtensions APIs are supported, so many Chrome Web Store extensions do not work.

browsers.name: Vivaldi
browsers.tagline: Chromium browser with workspaces, tab tiling, built-in mail and ad blocker

featureNotes.pinnedTabs: Classic pinned tabs; by default one can't be closed until it is unpinned, and there is no reset to the pinned page.
featureNotes.tabFolders: Tab Stacks group tabs one level deep, shown as a second row, an accordion or a compact stack.
featureNotes.autoArchiveTabs: Automatically closing inactive tabs is an Android setting; desktop only hibernates tabs with Memory Saver.
featureNotes.siteCustomization: Page Actions apply preset visual filters to the current tab only and are not saved per site.
featureNotes.arcImport: No Arc importer is documented; only generic browser and HTML-file bookmark import.
featureNotes.liveFolders: Built-in RSS Feed Reader in a Feeds panel, but feed items don't appear as sidebar tabs.
featureNotes.easels: Notes panel and a Capture screenshot tool, but no canvas.
featureNotes.miniPlayer: Vivaldi's Pop-out Video is started manually from a button or the context menu on the video, with no automatic pop-out on tab switch.
featureNotes.favorites: Vivaldi has a bookmarks bar and Speed Dial, but pinned tabs are kept per workspace rather than shown in every workspace.

browsers.name: Opera
browsers.tagline: Chromium browser with sidebar workspaces, built-in AI, VPN and ad blocker
browsers.priceNote: VPN Pro is a paid add-on

featureNotes.pinnedTabs: Classic pinned tabs; a pinned tab can't be closed until it is unpinned.
featureNotes.tabFolders: Tab Islands group tabs one level deep and stay available in the vertical tab strip.
featureNotes.commandBar: Search in Tabs (Ctrl+Space) finds open and recently closed tabs only; no history or browser actions are documented.
featureNotes.arcImport: Opera added an Arc profile importer in version 117 but does not document whether Spaces or pinned tabs carry over.
featureNotes.liveFolders: Personal News reader accepts RSS feeds reachable from the sidebar, but items don't appear as sidebar tabs.
featureNotes.easels: Pinboards hold notes, links and screenshots and Snapshot allows drawing on captures, but there are no live snippets or freeform canvas.
featureNotes.favorites: Opera has Speed Dial and a bookmarks bar, but no set of tabs shown in every workspace.

browsers.name: Microsoft Edge
browsers.tagline: Microsoft's Chromium-based browser with Copilot built in
browsers.priceNote: Browse with Copilot (agentic browsing) requires Microsoft 365 Premium, U.S. only

featureNotes.pinnedTabs: Classic pinned tabs: small icon-only tabs at the start of the tab row.
featureNotes.tabFolders: Chromium tab groups, made by dragging one tab onto another, with no nesting.
featureNotes.spaces: Edge Workspaces each open in their own window, with no switching between tab sets inside one sidebar.
featureNotes.commandBar: The address bar suggests open tabs and history, but there is no command palette for browser actions.
featureNotes.arcImport: Imports from other browsers and from bookmark HTML files, but has no Arc importer for Spaces or pinned tabs.
featureNotes.miniPlayer: Edge offers manual picture-in-picture through a button on video hover and the media control center, but documents no automatic switch to a mini player on tab change.
featureNotes.favorites: Edge has a favorites bar, and each Edge Workspace keeps its own favorites, but no set of tabs or icons is shown in every workspace.
featureNotes.adBlocking: Built-in Tracking Prevention blocks trackers but does not block ads.

browsers.name: Google Chrome
browsers.tagline: Google's browser, built on the open-source Chromium project

featureNotes.pinnedTabs: Classic pinned tabs: small icon-only tabs at the start of the tab row.
featureNotes.tabFolders: Named, coloured tab groups that sync across devices, with no nesting.
featureNotes.spaces: Only separate profiles in separate windows; there are no switchable sidebar spaces.
featureNotes.commandBar: The address bar searches tabs and history (@tabs, @history) and runs Chrome Actions, but there is no separate command palette.
featureNotes.arcImport: Imports from other browsers and from bookmark HTML files, but has no Arc importer for Spaces or pinned tabs.
featureNotes.miniPlayer: Chrome has manual picture-in-picture from the media controls, and enters it automatically on tab switch only on sites whose developers enable it and after you allow the site.
featureNotes.airTrafficControl: No link-to-profile routing; enterprise Legacy Browser Support only sends URLs to another browser.
featureNotes.favorites: Chrome offers a bookmarks bar but no set of tabs shown across tab groups or profiles.

browsers.name: Safari
browsers.tagline: Apple's built-in browser for Mac, iPhone and iPad

featureNotes.pinnedTabs: Pinned sites persist through restarts and always show the pinned site, but they sit in the tab bar, not their own section, and closing one removes it.
featureNotes.tabFolders: Tab Groups are named sets of tabs you switch between from the sidebar, with no nesting.
featureNotes.autoArchiveTabs: Closing tabs automatically after a day, week or month is documented for iPhone and iPad only.
featureNotes.linkPreview: Force Click shows a read-only preview popover, and only on Force Touch trackpads.
featureNotes.siteCustomization: Hide Distracting Items removes page elements per site but allows no custom CSS or JS.
featureNotes.arcImport: Imports directly only from Chrome and Firefox, plus HTML bookmark files; there is no Arc importer.
featureNotes.liveFolders: Safari's 'Notify Me' alerts you to page changes; it is not a feed reader.
featureNotes.easels: Can add page highlights to a macOS Quick Note, but has no screenshot tool or canvas.
featureNotes.miniPlayer: Safari on Mac enters Picture in Picture when you choose it from the Smart Search field, and moves a video to it automatically only from Video Viewer when you click another window.
featureNotes.favorites: Safari's Favorites are a bookmarks folder shown in the Favorites bar, kept separately for each profile.
featureNotes.adBlocking: Blocks cross-site trackers and fingerprinting but has no built-in ad blocker; ads need a content-blocker extension.

browsers.name: Mozilla Firefox
browsers.tagline: Mozilla's open-source browser with vertical tabs, split view and sync

featureNotes.pinnedTabs: Classic pinned tabs that reopen at startup and can be closed from the tab menu like other tabs.
featureNotes.tabFolders: Tab groups, added in Firefox 137, group tabs one level deep.
featureNotes.spaces: Only separate profiles in separate windows, with no switchable sidebar workspaces.
featureNotes.commandBar: The address bar searches tabs, history and bookmarks and runs a few quick actions, but it is not a full command palette.
featureNotes.linkPreview: Link Preview shows a summary card rather than the full page in an overlay, and is limited to some regions and English.
featureNotes.arcImport: The import wizard supports Chrome, Edge, Safari, Vivaldi and others but has no Arc option.
featureNotes.easels: Built-in Screenshots, plus Tab notes as an opt-in Labs feature, but no canvas.
featureNotes.miniPlayer: Firefox has a manual Picture-in-Picture toggle on videos, while auto-opening it on tab switch is off by default and only available as an experimental option (media.videocontrols.picture-in-picture.enable-when-switching-tabs.enabled).
featureNotes.favorites: Firefox offers a bookmarks toolbar (shown on new tabs by default) and pinned tabs, but no set of tabs shown across separate spaces.
featureNotes.adBlocking: Enhanced Tracking Protection blocks trackers but not ads.

browsers.name: Brave
browsers.tagline: Chromium-based browser with built-in ad blocking and Leo AI
browsers.priceNote: Leo AI Premium $14.99/mo or $149.99/yr; basic Leo is free

featureNotes.pinnedTabs: Classic pinned tabs at the top of the tab list; an optional flag shares them across windows.
featureNotes.tabFolders: Chromium tab groups that can be labelled and colour-coded, also in vertical tabs, with no nesting.
featureNotes.spaces: Only separate profiles in separate windows; there are no switchable sidebar spaces.
featureNotes.commandBar: The address bar searches tabs and history and Quick Commands run actions, but there is no separate command palette.
featureNotes.siteCustomization: Per-site JavaScript works only through custom scriptlets and filter rules in Shields developer mode, with no visual editor.
featureNotes.arcImport: Imports from other browsers and from bookmark HTML files, but has no Arc importer for Spaces or pinned tabs.
featureNotes.liveFolders: Brave News reads custom RSS feeds and can sit in the sidebar, but as a feed panel, not as tabs.
featureNotes.miniPlayer: Brave has a video Picture-in-Picture window, but its documentation describes no automatic mini player when you switch tabs.
featureNotes.favorites: Brave offers a bookmarks bar and pinned tabs but no set of tabs shown across separate spaces.

browsers.name: Floorp
browsers.tagline: Firefox-based browser with workspaces, split view and sidebar web panels

featureNotes.pinnedTabs: Classic pinned tabs from Firefox, shown in every workspace.
featureNotes.tabFolders: Firefox tab groups are on by default in Floorp's runtime, one level deep.
featureNotes.linkPreview: Uses Firefox's Link Preview, which shows a summary card rather than the full page in an overlay.
featureNotes.arcImport: Uses the Firefox import wizard (Chrome, Edge, Safari and others) with no Arc-specific option.
featureNotes.easels: Built-in sidebar Notes panel and Firefox Screenshots, but no canvas.
featureNotes.favorites: Pinned tabs and Panel Sidebar web panels appear in every workspace.
featureNotes.adBlocking: Firefox Enhanced Tracking Protection blocks trackers but not ads.

browsers.name: Comet
browsers.tagline: Chromium browser built around Perplexity's AI search and assistant
browsers.priceNote: Browser free; Perplexity Pro $20/mo or Max $200/mo for more AI

featureNotes.tabFolders: Official tips suggest grouping related tabs, but no folders or nesting are documented.
featureNotes.spaces: Only profiles, each opening in its own window; there are no switchable sidebar workspaces.
featureNotes.arcImport: Only the generic import of bookmarks and settings; there is no documented Arc importer for Spaces or pinned tabs.
featureNotes.favorites: Only pinned tabs and a bookmarks bar, and Comet has no switchable spaces for a shared set to appear across.

browsers.vibeCodedNote: Comet is closed source and launched in 2025. Perplexity requires AI coding tools company-wide, but has not said Comet was mostly AI-built.

browsers.name: Helium
browsers.tagline: Chromium-based browser with built-in uBlock Origin and no Google services

featureNotes.pinnedTabs: Classic Chromium pinned tabs, unchanged by Helium's patches.
featureNotes.tabFolders: Chromium tab groups are kept; Helium's patch only hides the group editor's footer.
featureNotes.spaces: Only tab groups and separate profiles in separate windows, with no switchable sidebar workspaces.
featureNotes.commandBar: The address bar searches open tabs, history and bookmarks, but there is no dedicated command palette.
featureNotes.miniPlayer: Keeps upstream Chromium's picture-in-picture video window, which the user starts manually, with no documented automatic pop-out on tab switch.
featureNotes.favorites: Only Chromium's pinned tabs and bookmarks bar (hidden by default in Helium), with no workspaces for a shared set to appear across.

browsers.name: Crest
browsers.tagline: Open-source Arc-style browser for Mac, iPhone and iPad
browsers.engineNote: Chromium by default on Mac, with WebKit per site; iPhone and iPad use WebKit.
browsers.priceNote: Optional donations via Ko-fi or Patreon; Mac build is Apple silicon only

featureNotes.tabFolders: Folders work in both saved and current tabs and can be nested, coloured and collapsed.
featureNotes.airTrafficControl: Routes links to a Space by URL pattern, not by source app.
featureNotes.adBlocking: The built-in ad and tracker ruleset works only on WebKit pages, so Chromium pages on Mac, the default there, need a blocking extension.

browsers.vibeCodedNote: The maker's README says AI tools assist development, and every recent pull request by the maintainer is marked 'AI tools helped produce this change'.

browsers.name: Aside
browsers.tagline: Chromium browser with built-in AI agents that complete tasks across websites
browsers.priceNote: Free plan with 500 AI credits/mo; Pro $20/mo, Max $200/mo; own API key or ChatGPT/Claude plan also usable

featureNotes.tabFolders: Tab groups with names, colours and icons, with no nesting documented.
featureNotes.commandBar: Tab Search finds open tabs and offers a few quick actions, but no palette covering history and browser commands is documented.
featureNotes.arcImport: Generic browser import (history, cookies, bookmarks); no Arc-specific importer documented.
featureNotes.miniPlayer: Auto picture-in-picture on tab switch is off by default; turn it on in Settings > General.
featureNotes.favorites: Offers pinned tabs, a bookmarks bar and a sidebar Bookmarks section, but no documented set of tabs shown across every profile.

browsers.vibeCodedNote: Aside is closed source and was built in 2026, and the co-founder's only statement says Codex and Claude could not help with many of the hardest parts, which does not settle how much was AI-written.

browsers.name: Phi
browsers.tagline: Chromium-based macOS browser with a built-in AI assistant and memory
browsers.priceNote: AI usage included for now; the FAQ says advanced features may become paid later

featureNotes.tabFolders: Folders live in the sidebar's bookmark tree, where New Nested Folder makes sub-folders; open tabs can also be put in Tab Groups.
featureNotes.commandBar: The Search Tabs palette covers only open, pinned, bookmarked and recently closed tabs, with no history search or browser actions.
featureNotes.arcImport: Has an Arc importer, but the docs do not say Arc Spaces or pinned tabs carry over.
featureNotes.liveFolders: New Tab page has an RSS feed widget, but no self-updating sidebar folders.

browsers.vibeCodedNote: The public Apache-2.0 macOS client repo was reviewed: about 23% of recent commits carry Claude co-author trailers and older history has almost none, which shows AI-assisted rather than AI-dominated work.

browsers.name: Yab (Yet Another Browser)
browsers.tagline: WebKit Mac browser modeled on Arc, with AI on your own plan
browsers.priceNote: No Yab account; AI features use your own Claude or ChatGPT plan, or Apple Intelligence

featureNotes.tabFolders: Folders can sit inside other folders, as in Arc, up to five levels deep.

browsers.vibeCodedNote: The browser itself is closed source with no maker statement; only side repos (plugins, MCP server, Homebrew tap) are public, and their Claude co-author trailers say nothing about the browser's own code.

browsers.name: Emerald
browsers.tagline: WebKit browser for Mac and iOS with Spaces, folders and profiles
browsers.priceNote: Premium unlocks unlimited Spaces and ad blocking.

featureNotes.pinnedTabs: Has a pinned section; release notes don't say whether closing a pinned tab keeps it.
featureNotes.tabFolders: Sidebar folders can be nested inside other folders, and pinned tabs can go in any folder.
featureNotes.commandBar: The search panel switches tabs and Spaces and searches recent and pinned tabs, but no browser actions are documented.
featureNotes.miniWindow: Little Emerald previews a site before adding it to a Space; unclear if it catches links opened from other apps.
featureNotes.siteCustomization: Premium Page Customization offers preset tweaks such as font and dark mode, with no custom CSS or JS.
featureNotes.arcImport: Imports from Arc, but release notes do not say what carries over.
featureNotes.chromeExtensions: Chrome Web Store extensions run through a WebKit conversion bridge, and the maker warns not all of them are compatible.

browsers.vibeCodedNote: The browser is closed source with no maker statement; release notes mention finishing one feature 'with Codex', which does not show the browser was built mostly with AI.

browsers.name: YARC
browsers.tagline: Open-source Electron browser recreating Arc's sidebar, Spaces and workflow

featureNotes.tabFolders: Pinned folders can be nested and collapsed, and Arc's nested folders import intact.
featureNotes.linkPreview: Peek opens only for links to other sites clicked inside pinned tabs or favorites, not for links in general.
featureNotes.airTrafficControl: Links from other apps open in a Little Arc window that uses a default profile or a profile remembered per site, but there are no rules that send links to a Space.
featureNotes.favorites: Favorites are shared by Spaces that use the same profile; new Spaces get their own profile by default.
featureNotes.chromeExtensions: Extensions install from the Chrome Web Store, but some APIs such as declarativeNetRequest are missing, so MV3 ad blockers install but do not block.

browsers.vibeCodedNote: 35 of the maker's 36 commits carry a Claude co-author trailer, all 22 of the maker's PRs say 'Generated with Claude Code', and the repo ships a CLAUDE.md.

browsers.name: Ardia
browsers.tagline: Open-source Chromium Mac browser pairing Arc's sidebar with Dia's look

featureNotes.tabFolders: Folders are called groups; Arc folders inside folders import and stay nested.
featureNotes.spaces: Profiles each have their own colour and, unless set to share data, their own logins and history.
featureNotes.autoArchiveTabs: Off by default; idle time is adjustable and cleaned tabs go to Recently Cleaned.
featureNotes.siteCustomization: There is no Boosts editor; restyling a site needs a userscript, run through the separate ardia command-line tool or an extension such as Tampermonkey.
featureNotes.liveFolders: GitHub and Docs live folders need your own access token.
featureNotes.airTrafficControl: Rules are written by hand in a JSON file and stay off until approved in Settings > Advanced > Automation; there is no rule editor.
featureNotes.favorites: Top Apps tiles are shared only by profiles that share browsing data, and each profile can opt out.
featureNotes.sync: Sync is end-to-end encrypted through your own iCloud Drive, so it only reaches other Macs.

browsers.vibeCodedNote: 780 of 799 sampled commits (from about 2,800) carry a 'Co-Authored-By: Claude' trailer, and the repo ships CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and a .claude folder.

browsers.name: Firn
browsers.tagline: Open-source native WebKit Mac browser with spaces, groups and link previews

featureNotes.pinnedTabs: There are no pinned tabs; Basecamp tiles (up to 12 per space) stay in place when closed, and groups keep tabs from being tidied away but close like normal tabs.
featureNotes.tabFolders: Groups are one level deep, and Arc's nested folders are flattened into their top folder on import.
featureNotes.autoArchiveTabs: Loose tabs unused for 7 days of using Firn move to a Tidied away box by default; 1 day, 30 days or never can be chosen.
featureNotes.arcImport: Arc favorites become Basecamp tiles and pinned tabs become groups; unpinned tabs and history stay in Arc.
featureNotes.miniPlayer: A sidebar card can pause or play a tab that is playing out of sight, but video doesn't pop out into a floating window.
featureNotes.favorites: Basecamp tiles sit at the top of the sidebar, but each space has its own set rather than one shared across spaces.
featureNotes.sync: Sync between devices through your own iCloud is planned for after the iPhone and iPad apps.

browsers.vibeCodedNote: 627 of the repo's 712 commits carry a 'Co-Authored-By: Claude' trailer, the repo ships a CLAUDE.md, and the About page says 'I'm not a professional developer' and 'Claude and I write the code together.' (counted 2026-11-05).

browsers.name: Blanc
browsers.tagline: Minimal Electron browser built around one compact command Island
browsers.priceNote: Every feature is free; optional Blanc Patron (US$30/year or US$4/month) unlocks nothing.

featureNotes.verticalTabs: The vertical tab rail is optional and off by default; the Island layout is the default.
featureNotes.pinnedTabs: Classic pinned tabs that lead the Island's tab dots; there is no separate persistent pinned section.
featureNotes.tabFolders: Named tab groups, one level deep; Arc folders import as tab groups.
featureNotes.spaces: Blanc Spaces save a window's tabs and groups and are switched from the Island rather than a sidebar.
featureNotes.autoArchiveTabs: Quiet Tabs only unload inactive background tabs to free memory; tabs are not closed.
featureNotes.linkPreview: Glance shows an already-open tab as a floating card over the page, not a clicked link.
featureNotes.miniWindow: Mini Window (added in 1.46.0) opens from a global shortcut that is off by default, but links from other apps never open in it.
featureNotes.siteCustomization: Only a per-site dark-website toggle (macOS only); no custom CSS or JavaScript.
featureNotes.arcImport: Imports selected Arc Spaces, pinned and Today tabs, and top-row Favorites; folders become tab groups, while history, passwords, Notes and Easels are not imported.
featureNotes.airTrafficControl: Rules in Settings → Profiles → Open links from other apps route domains to a profile or Space; rules are not synced.
featureNotes.favorites: Favorites are a bookmarks page plus up to eight Start Page pins, not tabs shown in every Space.
featureNotes.builtInAI: The site states Blanc does not include an AI assistant.
featureNotes.adBlocking: Blanc Blocker is on by default; full uBlock Origin can be chosen instead on supported builds.
featureNotes.chromeExtensions: No general extension runtime; only bundled uBlock Origin and an optional 1Password bridge.
featureNotes.sync: Optional end-to-end encrypted sync of Favorites and settings, plus open tabs and Spaces if chosen.

browsers.vibeCodedNote: All 100 most recent commits (checked 2026-11-05) carry a 'Co-Authored-By: Claude' trailer, and CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md sit at the repo root.

browsers.name: Cra
browsers.tagline: Open-source Arc-style sidebar browser for Apple silicon Macs
browsers.engineNote: Chromium (CEF), with WebKit for DRM video sites.
browsers.priceNote: Supported by GitHub Sponsors; sponsoring unlocks nothing.

featureNotes.siteCustomization: Arc-style Boosts are on the roadmap but not shipped.
featureNotes.liveFolders: Live folders cover GitHub pull requests and reviews only.
featureNotes.easels: Easels and Notes are on the roadmap but not shipped.
featureNotes.airTrafficControl: Set in Settings ▸ Tabs ▸ Links; Arc routes come along on import.
featureNotes.builtInAI: Only Tidy Tabs, Tidy Tab Titles and Tidy Downloads, running on-device through Apple Intelligence; there is no AI assistant.
featureNotes.adBlocking: A built-in list of more than 22,000 ad and tracker domains, on by default.
featureNotes.sync: Sync between Macs is on the roadmap under 'Later'.

browsers.vibeCodedNote: All 100 most recent commits (checked 2026-11-05) carry a 'Co-Authored-By: Claude' trailer, and a CLAUDE.md sits at the repo root.

browsers.name: Flecha
browsers.tagline: Open-source Chromium Mac browser for developers, with Arc-style Spaces and Peek

featureNotes.splitView: Split view holds two panes; 3 and 4 pane splits are on the roadmap.
featureNotes.autoArchiveTabs: Today tabs untouched for 12 hours are archived by default; 1 day, 7 days, 30 days or never can be chosen, and the archive is searchable.
featureNotes.linkPreview: Peek opens on its own only for links that leave a pinned tab or favorite; any other link can be peeked from its right-click menu.
featureNotes.siteCustomization: Boosts are per-site TypeScript and CSS files you write yourself on Flecha's Boosts page, with no visual editor.
featureNotes.arcImport: Spaces, pinned tabs with nested folders, favorites and history come over, but folders among unpinned tabs are flattened and Space colours, Easels and Boosts stay behind.
featureNotes.miniPlayer: Flecha has no mini player of its own, so video only floats through Chromium's standard picture-in-picture.
featureNotes.airTrafficControl: There are no link rules; one setting sends every link from other apps to a Flechinha window instead of a tab.
featureNotes.builtInAI: There is no AI assistant in the browser; an opt-in local MCP server lets outside coding agents such as Claude Code or Cursor read and drive your tabs.
featureNotes.adBlocking: Ad and tracker blocking uses EasyList and EasyPrivacy, is on by default and can be turned off in Settings.
featureNotes.sync: Flecha has no account, and its docs say it is not a fit if you need sync between computers.

browsers.name: Mise
browsers.tagline: Keyboard-first Electron browser with isolated workspaces and tab hibernation

featureNotes.pinnedTabs: Pinned tabs move to the top of the workspace's tab list and persist, and Mise refuses to close one until it is unpinned, but there is no separate pinned section.
featureNotes.spaces: Each workspace has its own tabs and its own cookie container, and you switch between them from the Workspace Dashboard (Ctrl+Shift+W) or by typing 'ws <name>' in the address bar.
featureNotes.commandBar: The Ctrl+P Command Centre runs browser actions only, while history and bookmark search live in the address bar and open tabs are listed in the separate Workspace Dashboard.
featureNotes.autoArchiveTabs: Idle tabs hibernate after 5 minutes to 1 hour to free memory, but they stay in the sidebar and are never closed.
featureNotes.linkPreview: Shift+click or the 'gh' hint opens a link in a temporary Glance overlay that Ctrl+Enter turns into a real tab.
featureNotes.siteCustomization: Per-site .user.js and .user.css files are injected natively, but you write them by hand in ~/.config/mise-browser/ rather than through an in-browser editor.
featureNotes.arcImport: There is no import tool for bookmarks, history or Arc data.
featureNotes.easels: A built-in Markdown notes panel (Ctrl+N) can take selected text, Reader View articles and page clippings, but there is no canvas or drawing.
featureNotes.miniPlayer: There is no floating player, and the docs don't say whether manual picture-in-picture works.
featureNotes.favorites: Quickmarks bind a site to one key you can jump to from any workspace with Ctrl+J, but nothing is shown on screen in every workspace.
featureNotes.adBlocking: Ghostery's blocking engine filters ads and trackers natively, and a shield button on each tab turns it off for trusted sites.
featureNotes.chromeExtensions: WebExtensions are deliberately unsupported; Mise offers local user scripts and styles instead.
featureNotes.sync: All data is kept in local files under ~/.config/mise-browser/ with no sync service.

browsers.vibeCodedNote: The maker's AI policy says 'A coding assistant writes code at my direction. I describe the feature or the fix, and the assistant writes the code'; the maker makes every commit, so none of about 305 commits carry AI trailers.

browsers.name: Nook
browsers.tagline: Open-source WebKit Mac browser with sidebar Spaces, live folders and Boosts

featureNotes.commandBar: The command palette searches open tabs in every space, history and the web, but it has no app actions or commands.
featureNotes.autoArchiveTabs: Idle tabs are unloaded from memory to save resources, but they stay in the sidebar until you close them.
featureNotes.arcImport: Arc import brings over spaces, nested folders, pinned tabs, favorites, colors and extensions, with Arc's favorites copied into each space.
featureNotes.miniPlayer: Off by default; turning on Settings > General > Keep videos playing in the sidebar moves a playing video into a small player above the sidebar when you leave its tab.
featureNotes.favorites: Favorites are icon tiles at the top of the sidebar, but each space keeps its own set rather than one shared across spaces.
featureNotes.builtInAI: Ask Nook, a sidebar chat that answers questions about the page, is opt-in and runs on Apple Intelligence on macOS 26 or on your own Gemini, OpenRouter, Ollama or OpenAI-compatible provider.
featureNotes.adBlocking: The built-in ad and tracker blocker is off by default and is turned on in Settings > Ad Blocker.
featureNotes.chromeExtensions: An Add to Nook button installs extensions from the Chrome Web Store, but they run on WebKit's WKWebExtension engine and a Nook developer has said on GitHub that not all of them work yet.
featureNotes.sync: iCloud sync for spaces and tabs is on the roadmap but has not been started.

browsers.vibeCodedNote: The v1.4.0 tag ships a CLAUDE.md, but of about 1,400 commits, only 5 of the latest 100 carry AI trailers, and the maintainers have made no statement that it was built mostly with AI (counted 2026-11-05).

browsers.name: Ortix
browsers.tagline: Native WebKit Mac browser with spaces, profiles, split view and AI
browsers.priceNote: The free version allows up to 3 spaces; Ortix Pro costs $5.99 a month after a 7-day trial, or comes with a Setapp membership.

featureNotes.pinnedTabs: Each space has its own pinned tabs, listed before the tab strip, but the site doesn't say whether a closed pin stays in the sidebar.
featureNotes.tabFolders: Collections are named groups of tabs that fold away, and the site doesn't mention nesting them.
featureNotes.spaces: The free version allows up to 3 spaces, and each space can use its own profile with separate cookies and sign-ins.
featureNotes.commandBar: Quick Search (Command-T) finds open tabs, history and bookmarks and does sums, but no browser commands are listed.
featureNotes.autoArchiveTabs: Tabs left alone for hours are unloaded only when the Mac runs low on memory, and they aren't closed.
featureNotes.linkPreview: Quick View is a popover browser, but the site only says it catches login and OAuth popups, not that it previews ordinary links.
featureNotes.miniWindow: Mini Browser is a small window that floats above other apps, and only Setapp's listing says it opens for links clicked in an email.
featureNotes.arcImport: Ortix imports Arc spaces and tabs, but the site doesn't say whether Arc's pins and folders come across as well.
featureNotes.easels: The home page holds notes and to-do lists, and a Saved Gallery keeps visual bookmarks.
featureNotes.miniPlayer: Video follows you into Picture in Picture when you leave its tab, but this automatic mode needs Ortix Pro.
featureNotes.favorites: Favourites appear as a grid on the home page, not as icons shown in every space.
featureNotes.builtInAI: The EVVE assistant runs on models on your Mac or on your own API key, and its agent mode needs Ortix Pro.
featureNotes.sync: Bookmarks, tabs and spaces sync through iCloud, but Ortix only runs on Macs.

browsers.vibeCodedNote: Ortix is closed source, was first released in December 2025, and SystemBionic has made no statement on whether it was written mostly with AI coding tools.

browsers.name: Polar
browsers.tagline: Chromium AI browser whose agent runs long web tasks for you
browsers.priceNote: Free tier with 1,000 starter credits plus 50 a day; Individual from $20/mo, Teams $25/seat/mo

featureNotes.miniPlayer: Polar's release notes mention picture-in-picture windows, but no automatic floating player on tab switch is documented.
featureNotes.builtInAI: The browser is built around an AI agent that runs tasks across websites, on your computer or in Polar Cloud, and uses credits.
featureNotes.chromeExtensions: Release notes say the Chrome Web Store no longer asks you to switch to Chrome and fix prompts from extensions.

browsers.vibeCodedNote: The maker writes that three people with no experience forked Chromium 'with coding agents' and that a team of agents built the Windows version in about a week.

browsers.name: Sailfish
browsers.tagline: Open-source Arc-style sidebar browser for Mac
browsers.engineNote: Chromium, with WebKit for some streaming sites.

featureNotes.autoArchiveTabs: Today tabs you haven't looked at in 12 hours archive themselves; the time can be changed in Settings > Profiles.
featureNotes.favorites: Favorites belong to a profile, so they show in every space that uses that profile.
featureNotes.airTrafficControl: Space Linking in Settings > Links sends links from other apps to a chosen space, the most recent space or Little Sailfish by URL.
featureNotes.adBlocking: uBlock Origin ships built in and on by default; it can be turned off in Settings > General.
featureNotes.easels: Capture (Shift-Cmd-2) saves page screenshots to the Library's Media, but there is no notes or canvas feature.
featureNotes.builtInAI: Sailfish's own comparison page lists no AI; Tidy sorts Today tabs into groups on the Mac but is not described as an AI feature.
featureNotes.sync: No account or sync; the FAQ says sync may come later.

browsers.name: Search
browsers.tagline: Small open-source WebKit Mac browser with Arc-style spaces, pins and peek

featureNotes.verticalTabs: Tabs can sit down the left or right side or across the top; set it in Settings > Tabs.
featureNotes.tabFolders: Tab groups are one level deep; Arc folders come in as tab groups.
featureNotes.commandBar: Cmd-T can open a floating address field that finds history, bookmarks and a few app commands, and Cmd-K lists open tabs, but there is no full command palette.
featureNotes.autoArchiveTabs: Off until you choose a time in Settings > Tabs > Close tabs you leave alone (12 hours to a month); pinned, named and grouped tabs stay.
featureNotes.linkPreview: Peek opens on Shift-click once turned on in Settings > General.
featureNotes.miniWindow: Links from other apps can open in a small window, turned on in Settings > General.
featureNotes.siteCustomization: Hide-element (Shift-Cmd-H) removes chosen page elements per site, and Darken light pages recolours them, but there is no custom CSS or JS editor.
featureNotes.arcImport: Brings over Arc spaces, pinned tabs, favourites (as pins), folders (as tab groups), bookmarks, history and passwords; Arc notes, easels and boosts don't come over.
featureNotes.miniPlayer: Floating video on tab switch is a setting (Float the video on its own: Switching tabs).
featureNotes.favorites: Pins can be kept in every space, above each space's own pins, once turned on in Settings > Tabs.
featureNotes.builtInAI: Summarize Page and Ask About This Page exist on the main branch but were held back from the 1.0.9 release.
featureNotes.chromeExtensions: Installs from the Chrome Web Store on macOS 15.4 or later, running on WebKit's extension engine, and not every extension works yet.
featureNotes.sync: No account or sync by design; everything stays on the Mac.

browsers.vibeCodedNote: All 300 of the latest commits checked (8 Oct to 5 Nov 2026, of 853 total) carry a 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5' trailer, and the README names dev builds after claude/ branches.

browsers.name: Vane
browsers.tagline: Native Swift and WebKit Mac browser closely modeled on Arc

featureNotes.tabFolders: Pinned folders nest up to three levels deep, shallower than Arc.
featureNotes.autoArchiveTabs: Today tabs archive after 12 hours by default; 24 hours, 7 days, 30 days or never can be chosen.
featureNotes.miniWindow: Links from other apps open in Little Vane by default; Settings > Links can send them to the current Space instead.
featureNotes.arcImport: A dedicated Import from Arc flow brings Spaces, pins, splits, passwords, sessions and Air Traffic Control rules, though some row types are skipped.
featureNotes.liveFolders: Live Folders follow GitHub pull requests only, and need a GitHub sign-in or personal access token.
featureNotes.favorites: Favourites belong to a profile, so they show in every Space of that profile but not in other profiles' Spaces.
featureNotes.builtInAI: Page summaries use Apple's on-device model; cloud features such as tab grouping need your own API key.
featureNotes.adBlocking: On by default, but supports only part of the EasyList filter syntax.
featureNotes.chromeExtensions: Installs from the Chrome Web Store, but the WebKit runtime doesn't support every extension API.
featureNotes.miniPlayer: Automatic Picture in Picture is on by default and can be minimized into a sidebar player.
featureNotes.airTrafficControl: Rules in Settings > Links match a link's URL with 'contains' or 'is equal to' and send it to a Space or Little Vane.

browsers.vibeCodedNote: 147 of 590 commits carry a Claude co-author trailer (all from the first two months), 424 of 562 PRs come from 'codex/' branches, and a root AGENTS.md tells the agent to implement, review and squash-merge each change (counted 2026-11-05).

browsers.name: Viola
browsers.tagline: Calm Chromium browser with workspaces, groups, splits and no AI
browsers.priceNote: Starter is free; Pro (€29/month, 20% off yearly) adds unlimited workspaces, a mobile simulator and the mini player everywhere.

featureNotes.pinnedTabs: Viola has pinned tabs, but its site doesn't say whether they behave like Arc's.
featureNotes.tabFolders: Tab groups collect related tabs under one label; nested folders aren't mentioned.
featureNotes.spaces: Unlimited workspaces need the paid Pro plan.
featureNotes.miniWindow: Mini Viola opens quick links in a compact window, but the release notes don't say it catches links from other apps.
featureNotes.arcImport: Release notes mention browser imports but not an Arc importer.
featureNotes.miniPlayer: The site describes popping a video into a player that follows you between workspaces, with no mention of automatic pop-out; 'mini player everywhere' is a Pro feature.
featureNotes.favorites: Viola has Favorites, but its site doesn't say whether they show in every workspace.
featureNotes.sync: End-to-end encrypted sync of tabs, groups, pins and workspaces needs a Viola account.

browsers.vibeCodedNote: Viola is closed source and first shipped in 2026, and the maker has made no statement on whether it was written mostly with AI coding tools.

browsers.name: Yalqen
browsers.tagline: Open-source Electron browser for Mac web developers

featureNotes.pinnedTabs: Pinned tabs show as circular icons at the top of the tab panel; Arc-style persistence isn't documented.
featureNotes.tabFolders: One level of tab groups only.
featureNotes.spaces: Only separate profiles, each in its own browser instance, plus saved workspaces that reopen in a new window.
featureNotes.arcImport: Imports from Chrome, Brave, Edge and Firefox; the site says there is no Arc import yet.
featureNotes.miniPlayer: A sidebar media card controls playback, but video doesn't pop out into a floating window.
featureNotes.builtInAI: The AI panel runs Claude, Codex or Gemini coding agents that you set up yourself.
featureNotes.chromeExtensions: Installs from the Chrome Web Store since 0.2.6, but not every extension works.

browsers.vibeCodedNote: 66 of 592 commits carry Claude trailers, nearly all from the first weeks; none in the latest 100.

browsers.name: Zephium
browsers.tagline: Rust browser on system web engines, with an AI agent canvas
browsers.engineNote: WebKit on macOS; WebView2 (Chromium) on Windows.
browsers.priceNote: The browser is free; Zephium AI includes 250 free credits, and Pro and Max add 2,000 or 10,000 a month. Your own keys or a local model also work.

featureNotes.pinnedTabs: Each Space has Pinned and Today sections, but the docs don't say whether closing a pinned tab keeps it.
featureNotes.tabFolders: Settings > Tabs > Allow folders gives one level of folders within each Space.
featureNotes.commandBar: The launcher (Cmd+Shift+Space) finds tabs, history, notes and commands, and opens over any app.
featureNotes.autoArchiveTabs: Settings > Tabs > Archive Today tabs closes idle tabs after 12 hours, a day or a week, and they stay in History.
featureNotes.siteCustomization: Only Hide Elements, which hides parts of a page per site; there is no per-site CSS or JS.
featureNotes.arcImport: Imports Arc bookmarks, history and Essentials, but not Spaces or pinned tabs.
featureNotes.easels: Notes keeps Markdown notes and the Work canvas holds tabs, files and agent results, but there is no drawing canvas for clipping pages.
featureNotes.miniPlayer: A setting in Settings > Tabs keeps a playing video in a small window when you switch tabs.
featureNotes.favorites: Essentials belong to each Space, so they don't show across every Space.
featureNotes.builtInAI: AI is optional: Zephium AI, your own OpenAI, Anthropic or Gemini key, or a local model.
featureNotes.chromeExtensions: Major Chrome Web Store extensions install, but some use features Zephium doesn't support yet.
